blocks.text: P-pop heavyweights BINI and SB19 have submitted entries for consideration at the 2027 Grammys, including submissions in the newly introduced Best Asian Pop Performance category. BINI’s entries for consideration include the Best New Artist category, Best Asian Pop Music Performance for “Unang Kilig,” and Best Song Written for Visual Media for “A Parallel World.” “Let’s keep supporting BINI, and Filipino music and talent as we take our step to the global stage,” the girl group’s label, Star Music, said in its announcement on Monday, Oct. 12.
